# iosxe_eap_profile (Resource)

This resource can manage the EAP Profile configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_eap_profile" "example" {
  name            = "EAP1"
  description     = "My EAP Profile"
  method_fast     = true
  method_gtc      = true
  method_leap     = true
  method_md5      = true
  method_mschapv2 = true
  method_peap     = true
  method_tls      = true
  pki_trustpoint  = "TP1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Specify a profile name (max 63 characters)

### Optional

- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `description` (String) Provide a description for the EAP profile
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `method_fast` (Boolean) EAP-FAST method allowed.
- `method_gtc` (Boolean) EAP-GTC method allowed
- `method_leap` (Boolean) EAP-LEAP method allowed
- `method_md5` (Boolean) EAP-MD5 method allowed
- `method_mschapv2` (Boolean) EAP-MSCHAPV2 method allowed
- `method_peap` (Boolean) EAP-PEAP method allowed
- `method_tls` (Boolean) EAP-TLS method allowed
- `pki_trustpoint` (String) Set the default pki trustpoint

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_eap_profile.example "<name>"
```
